name: Kernel Tutorials
description: Interactive, presentation-style tutorials on tt-metal kernel programming, built as companions to the kernel_dojo exercises. The Circular Buffer Dojo steps through reserve, push, wait and pop, the DST handshake, and the classic deadlock and wrong-data bugs as live simulations of the exercise kernels; the Throughput Dojo covers multi-core scaling, the DRAM-bandwidth knee, batched NoC transactions, K-accumulation in DST, operand reuse and math fidelity. Each tutorial is one self-contained HTML file.
author: mstojkovicTT
